container.venv_storage: named Docker volume ravel-premium-venv-t01 mounted over the worktree .venv

host.note: Host is not canonical; canonical gates run in the Ubuntu 24.04 container. Host use is limited to editing, Git plumbing, and Docker orchestration.

git.why_relative: The absolute Windows gitdir cannot be followed by WSL or the Linux container. The relative path resolves in Windows, WSL, and the /workspace mount.

services.note: Services run on the WSL host; the canonical container uses --network host. MinIO image was unavailable from the allowed registries at T01 time, so MinIO-dependent tests are not PASS.

database_test_lock.default_dir: <repo-parent>/.ravel-test-locks (Git common dir parent; /workspace/.ravel-test-locks in the canonical container)
database_test_lock.entrypoints: premium-task, release-gate and direct pytest share it; pytest child owns the lock, runners lock only non-pytest database commands; process-local reentrancy prevents fixture self-deadlock

source_binding.source_digest: computed by scripts/premium_task.py digest; bound in each evidence manifest
